problem_solving_approach.title: Understand the Problem
problem_solving_approach.description: Read the problem statement carefully, identify inputs/outputs, and clarify constraints

problem_solving_approach.title: Think of Brute Force
problem_solving_approach.description: Start with the simplest approach, even if it's not optimal

problem_solving_approach.title: Optimize
problem_solving_approach.description: Look for patterns, consider different data structures, and optimize time/space complexity

problem_solving_approach.title: Code
problem_solving_approach.description: Write clean, readable code with proper variable names and comments

problem_solving_approach.title: Test
problem_solving_approach.description: Test with edge cases, empty inputs, and boundary conditions

tips: Practice coding on whiteboard or paper
Explain your thought process while coding
Learn multiple solutions for common problems
Understand time and space complexity analysis
Prepare STAR format answers for common questions
Have specific examples ready for leadership, teamwork, and problem-solving
Research the company culture and values
Prepare thoughtful questions to ask the interviewer
Get plenty of sleep the night before
Bring copies of your resume and a notebook
Stay calm and think out loud during problem-solving

common_mistakes_to_avoid.solution: Always understand the problem and plan your approach first
Think about empty inputs, single elements, and boundary conditions
Always analyze and discuss the complexity of your solution
Walk through your code with sample inputs before submitting
If stuck, try explaining your thought process or ask for hints
